result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by replacing Licensor’s unilateral seven-year option with successive 12-month renewals requiring mutual written agreement and by capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. The change is narrowly tailored and leaves unrelated termination rights intact. Drafting quality is reduced by the awkward phrase “successive additional periods” and, more importantly, by leaving the directly related and grammatically incomplete Article IV.II language (“mutual written of the parties”) uncorrected, creating avoidable redundancy and uncertainty among Sections I–III.
